scope: Clean quiesced PostgreSQL 15 database inside an arm64 Machinen VM restored through vmstate snapshot/restore and verified with psql.
promotionEffect: Adds a verified PostgreSQL/psql VM-state snapshot/restore proof, but does not raise the public portable PostgreSQL cross-architecture claim.

proofs.proves: A real PostgreSQL 15 service in an arm64 Machinen VM was snapshotted and restored with vmstate, and target psql verification matched the source workload output.
proofs.claimUse: narrow PostgreSQL/psql VM-state proof only; not a cross-architecture public PostgreSQL claim
proofs.next: Run retained native amd64<->arm64 PostgreSQL product E2E before raising portable PostgreSQL support.
